atoms.a: There are 25 lemons divided into 5 bags. How many lemons are in each bag?
There are 100 chocolates divided into 10 boxes. How many chocolates are in each box?
There are 30 birds equally spread across 5 branches. How many birds are on each branch?
There are 60 cars spread across a 5-storey car park. How many cars are there on each floor?
There are 4 bags of marbles. There are 10 marbles in each bag. How many marbles are there altogether?
A bookcase has 6 shelves. There are 8 books on each shelf. How many books are there altogether?
There are 8 pots of pens. Each pot has 11 pens in them. How many pens are there altogether?
There are 8 lanes in a bowling alley. Each lane has 7 bowling balls. How many bowling balls are there in the bowling alley?
